The policy prohibits the seller from disclosing, requesting, agreeing to, or facilitating any payment-app information (e.g., WeChat ID or QR code) for off-platform transactions. Buyer requests alone do not excuse seller compliance; each seller proposal independently violates the policy by actively enabling circumvention of the official platform’s payment system.
